d:
The Clippers defeated the Pelicans, 139-123 tonight in LA. Darius Garland finished with a team-high 24 points along with 10 assists and 3 three pointers for the Clippers, while Brook Lopez tallied 20 points, 7 rebounds in the game. Trey Murphy III recorded 26 points, 7 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Clippers improve their record to 2-7 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-6 for the season.
